concepts.name: The Rate Of A Reaction 195 UNIT 4 The Ra
concepts.simple_definition: The Rate of a Reaction 195 UNIT 4 The rate of a chemical reaction measures the change in concentration of a reactant or a product per unit time
concepts.deep_explanation: This means that the rate of a reaction determines how fast the concentration of a reactant or product changes with time
